steps.en: Install the desktop app and point it at your repository
steps.zh: 安装桌面应用，指向你的仓库

steps.en: The app starts the local daemon for you — no CLI required
steps.zh: 应用替你启动本地 daemon——不需要 CLI

steps.en: Create a worker: choose one of 28 supported agents and a model, describe the task
steps.zh: 新建 worker：选一个受支持的 agent 和模型，写清任务

steps.en: Gives the worker its own branch and isolated git worktree
steps.zh: 给这个 worker 配上自己的分支和隔离的 git worktree

steps.en: Tracks PR, CI, review and conflicts, and places the card on the live Kanban
steps.zh: 跟踪 PR、CI、review 和冲突，把卡片放上实时看板

steps.en: Flags blocked sessions as Needs you and returns failures to the owning agent
steps.zh: 把卡住的会话标成 Needs you，把失败送回拥有它的 agent

value.en: N coding agents stay in their own lanes, and only work that truly needs you comes back to you
value.zh: N 个编码 agent 各走各的车道，只有真正需要你的活才会回到你面前

sources: https://github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator README.md 'Install' (per-platform installer files incl. agent-orchestrator-darwin-arm64.dmg; 'The desktop app runs the daemon for you, so no CLI is required')

https://github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator README.md 'Workers execute focused tasks' + 'One workflow, from idea to merge' (New task; agent+model choice; per-worker branch+worktree; feedback to owning agent)
https://github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator README.md 'Supported agents' (28 coding agents) + 'The Kanban keeps the system legible' (Working / Needs you / In review / Ready to merge)
